subject.title: Feature request: Auto-send intent/acknowledgment text message before agent processing

question: Should OpenClaw add a unified cross-channel text acknowledgement contract before agent processing, route this to channel-specific placeholder features, or intentionally rely on existing reactions/typing/progress cues?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix adds new visible messaging behavior and likely new config/API surface across channel/plugin boundaries, so maintainer product intent is required before implementation.

options.title: Sponsor Unified Ack Text
options.body: Add a default-off messages.ackText or non-terminal plugin hook that channels can implement consistently with scope and per-channel/account overrides.

options.title: Split By Channel
options.body: Keep this broad issue as design context and let Slack, Telegram, Discord, WhatsApp, WebChat, and Feishu land narrower default-off placeholder lifecycles independently.

options.title: Decline Text Acks
options.body: Document reactions, typing, status reactions, and channel progress drafts as the supported acknowledgement surfaces and close the text-message direction.

recommendation.title: Sponsor Unified Ack Text
recommendation.body: Add a default-off messages.ackText or non-terminal plugin hook that channels can implement consistently with scope and per-channel/account overrides.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses reply lifecycle, channel UX, and config policy, where steipete has the strongest adjacent history and prior review involvement.
